description: Set up orch in one sitting: config in the BMad custom layers, a subproject registry drafted from the repo and confirmed by you, the sprint-status merge driver, stock-skill overrides, the CI gate, an optional pre-push hook and dependency checks. Safe to re-run: a re-run shows what is in place and revisits only what you pick; -H in a new clone re-registers the merge driver.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{inline values: skip prompts with provided values}|{hook: install the pre-push hook}|{coord=<path>: coordination checkout for the hook in a polyrepo code repo}|{ci=github,gitlab: install the CI gate}|{registry=<plan.json>: write a confirmed registry plan headless}

description: Validate the epics against the subproject registry before implementation: one subproject per story, dependencies that follow registry imports, breaking contract changes split into expand, migrate, narrow. Returns PASS, CONCERNS or FAIL.
Pick a ready story ranked by what it unblocks, claim it atomically, prepare its worktree and node context, and hand it to bmad-build. Also resumes, releases or takes over claims.
Run or explain the deterministic pre-merge gate for a story PR: scope, marker, pins, contract conformance, breaking changes, sprint status. Same verdict locally and in CI.
Show every epic across all subprojects: story states, claimants, blockers, critical path and anomalies such as stale claims, stuck reviews or pin drift, with the action each one offers.
Close an epic whose stories are all merged: archive story markers and record epic-N done through two gated PR passes, then hand the retro data to bmad-retrospective.
Generate a self-contained HTML or PDF epic report: story DAG coloured by state, critical path, bottlenecks, anomalies and per-subproject progress.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{epic: epic number}|{--pdf: also render PDF}

description: Rebuild sprint-status.yaml from the merged story markers when it lags behind, then open a PR with the result.
